why: The gallery imports Mantine in 13 files for provider, theme and tokens only; moving it first proves the 1.x floor rows on a small app without touching the desktop app.
what: shutterflow repo (consumer_repo): apps/gallery/**, e2e/gallery/**. App-scoped install: apps/gallery pins basalt-ui 3.0.0-next.N while the root stays on 1.40.3 until desktop cuts over. N is floors.G1.next in ~/SourceRoot/basalt-ui/scripts/fleet.json; before starting run `npm view basalt-ui@3.0.0-next.N version`: if it prints nothing, stop and file a signal (the release is the owner's make release).
must_not_touch: apps/desktop/**, apps/share/**, apps/key-broker/**, apps/origin-gateway/**, root package.json and Makefile, src-tauri
any basalt-ui checkout (no hand edits upstream)
contract: Read in the basalt-ui checkout (~/SourceRoot/basalt-ui): concepts/migration-release.md sections 6.1 and 6.4; migrations/1.x rows from v3-mig-rows-1x. Declare "basalt": {"sibling": true} in apps/gallery/package.json; own .basalt/manifest.json in apps/gallery. share-deploy.yml ships it on push.
change: Run basalt-ui migrate --from 1.40.3 --profile parts in apps/gallery, then replace @mantine/core and hooks (provider, theme, tokens in 13 files) with BasaltProvider, tokens.css and ui/* primitives. Re-key e2e/gallery/sharing-ux.spec.ts from --mantine-color-red-5 to the v3 token. Rule: generated oxlint preset scoped to apps/gallery. Skill: none (root managed layer untouched). Tests: the gallery bun tests and the e2e spec.
commits: Shutterflow's convention: conventional with scope (feat(gallery): ...), no attribution.
proof: Gate (hygiene.check is false): bun run --filter @shutterflow/gallery typecheck, test and build, plus make check-changed; make verify proves the share deploy after merge.
acceptance: git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD lists only apps/gallery/**, e2e/gallery/** and bun.lock
bun run --filter @shutterflow/gallery typecheck, test and build exit 0
make check-changed exits 0 and prints the gallery package as selected
grep -rn '@mantine' apps/gallery/src apps/gallery/package.json is empty and the root package.json still pins basalt-ui 1.40.3
basalt-ui sync --check, doctor and lint exit 0 from apps/gallery's local bin; waivers at or under the fleet.json row ceiling
grep -rni mantine e2e/gallery is empty and the repo's e2e typecheck passes; running the spec needs the lab machine (v3-sf-cutover), which the PR states rather than claims
git log --format=%s origin/master..HEAD matches ^(feat|fix|chore|refactor|test)\(gallery\): (shutterflow's scoped convention)
make verify passes after the merge deployed
out_of_scope: apps/desktop, root basalt-ui pin, Makefile and src-tauri, baselines regeneration for desktop, G2 symbols.
